summary: Youtarr is a self-hosted media tool that automates downloading videos from specified YouTube channels on a recurring schedule. It features a web interface for browsing and picking specific media, and outputs files compatible with popular home theatre platforms like Plex, Jellyfin, Kodi, and Emby.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want to curate offline archives of specific YouTube creators and integrate them smoothly into an existing media server setup.
watchOut: Relying on scheduled scraping of third-party platforms means maintenance overhead when the upstream site changes its structure or blocks download mechanisms.
deployNotes: As a Docker container, it typically requires persistent volume mounts for downloaded media storage and configuration data.
